PROGRESS NOTE

The patient returns for scheduled surveillance following transcatheter aortic valve
replacement performed several years prior. No new symptoms are reported.

Echocardiogram Summary: Left ventricular systolic function is preserved. The prosthetic
transcatheter valve leaflets move well. The mean gradient is 15 mm Hg, stable compared to
the prior study, and mild paravalvular regurgitation is again noted, unchanged from
previous assessments.

Assessment and Plan: Stable prosthetic valve function post-TAVR. Continue current
antiplatelet regimen. Return to clinic in twelve months with repeat echocardiography.
